CustomField.description: calculated field that allows for rolling month filter. Numbers the preceding months sequentially- current month is '0' and last month is '1'.
CustomField.formula: IF ( YEAR( TODAY() ) > YEAR(DATEVALUE(CreatedDate)), (MONTH( TODAY()) - MONTH( DATEVALUE(CreatedDate)) + ((YEAR( TODAY() ) - YEAR(DATEVALUE(CreatedDate))) * 12) ) , MONTH( TODAY()) - MONTH( DATEVALUE(CreatedDate)))
CustomField.label: Create Date Rolling Month
